cases.reason: Correct MaxRequests=2 one-callback/two-success sequence; see Allow closure and onSuccess; benchmark B02.
OnStateChange runs under mutex in State/setState, reentry via State or Counts blocks; benchmark B04.
No serialized wrapper reassignment or changed receiver is described.

findings.reason: Source beforeRequest, Execute, onSuccess/onFailure and defaultReadyToTrip support sequence with stated defaults.
Execute defer calls afterRequest(false); onFailure increments then invokes ReadyToTrip and may itself panic, subject to stated conditions.
Allow closure has no once guard; afterRequest generation guard and onSuccess/onFailure implement the described outcomes.
HalfOpen has no expiry and admission is exhausted; without another outstanding completion it remains.
afterRequest calls currentState; Counts does not; currentState advances expired generations and open state.
setState invokes callback while callers hold mutex; State and Counts reacquire that mutex.
